# Terms of Service

**Last updated:** July 14, 2026

## 1. Acceptance of Terms

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern the use of the Forja application ("App", "Service"), developed by Luiz Henrique Wessel ("we", "our"). By creating an account or using the App, you ("User") state that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy.

You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of legal majority in your place of residence, to use the App. If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use the App.

## 2. Nature of the Service — Not medical advice

Forja is a personal tracking and gamification tool to support the user in reducing compulsive habits. **The App is not a medical device, does not offer diagnosis, treatment, or professional health advice, and does not replace therapy, psychological, or medical care.**

Do not use the App in emergency situations. In case of crisis, suicidal ideation, or risk to your health, immediately seek an emergency service (192/193 in Brazil) or CVV (188).

## 3. Your account and responsibilities

- You are responsible for keeping your access credentials confidential.
- You agree not to use the App for illegal purposes, not to attempt to access other users' data, not to reverse-engineer the App, and not to create multiple accounts through automated means.
- You are solely responsible for the accuracy of the information you enter (including entries in the Trigger Journal, streak progress, and achievements).

## 4. Sensitive data — Trigger Journal

The information you log in the Trigger Journal may include data about your mental health and behavior, considered **sensitive data** under the LGPD (Brazilian Law No. 13,709/2018). This data is handled with an extra layer of protection, used only to provide the App's functionality to you, and is not shared with third parties for advertising purposes. More details in the Privacy Policy.

## 5. XP, streak, and rank system

Progress (XP and ranks) is a symbolic representation within the App, with no monetary or exchange value. Accumulated XP is permanent; only the current streak resets in case of a relapse logged by the user. We may adjust scoring rules, ranks, or levels at any time, without this giving rise to any right to compensation.

## 6. Free plan and Pro subscription

- The App offers a free tier and a paid subscription tier ("Pro") with additional features.
- Payments, auto-renewal, and subscription cancellation are processed by the App Store (Apple) or Google Play, depending on the store used, and are also subject to those platforms' terms.
- You may cancel auto-renewal at any time directly in the settings of the corresponding app store. Refunds follow Apple/Google's policies.

## 7. Content ownership

You retain all rights to the content you enter into the App (entries, notes). You grant us a limited, non-exclusive license solely to store and process that content for the purpose of operating the App for you. We do not use your personal content to train third-party models or publish it without your explicit action.

## 8. App updates

We may release updates periodically, including fixes, improvements, or removal of features. We recommend keeping the App up to date at all times; features may not work correctly on outdated versions.

## 9. Disclaimer of warranties

The App is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including warranties of fitness for a particular purpose or of uninterrupted, error-free operation.

## 10. Limitation of liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, Luiz Henrique Wessel will not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use the App. Our total liability, under any circumstances, is limited to the amount you paid in the last 6 months (if any).

## 11. Changes to these Terms

We may change these Terms at any time. Material changes will be communicated within the App. Continued use after a change means you accept the new Terms.

## 12. Governing law and jurisdiction

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil. The courts of Toledo/PR are elected to settle any disputes, except where otherwise required by law.

## 13. Contact

Questions about these Terms: heyxist3r@gmail.com.
